---
title: "Where My Research Takes Me"
format: html
editor: visual
body-classes: page-map
---

As an open-source GIS enthusiast, I thought it would be fun to create an interactive map of all the places I have conducted research, as well as all of the places I have been fortunate enough to travel to for conferences, workshops, and colloquia.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

# -------------------------
# Data
# -------------------------
sites <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name, ~popup, ~lng, ~lat,
  "Berg River", "Berg River Watershed, South Africa", 18.861, -33.986,
  "Eerste River", "Eerste River Watershed, South Africa", 18.946042, -33.977875,
  "Merced Vernal Pools", "Merced Vernal Pools and Grasslands Reserve, Merced, CA, USA", -120.366, 37.243,
  "Grayson Riverbend Preserve", "Grayson Riverbend Preserve, Grayson, CA, USA", -121.175705, 37.573927,
  "Russian River Watershed", "Russian River Watershed, CA, USA", -123.006, 38.508,
  "Cosumnes River Preserve", "Cosumnes River Preserve, CA, USA", -121.440734, 38.265969
)

confs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name, ~popup, ~lng, ~lat, ~year,
  "Washington, D.C. (AGU24)", "AGU24 — Washington, D.C. (Oral)", -77.0369, 38.9072, 2024,
  "Davis, CA", "Labor and Automation in California Agriculture Annual Meeting — UC Davis (Poster)", -121.7405, 38.5449, 2024,
  "Long Beach, CA (ESA)", "ESA Annual Meeting — Long Beach, CA (Poster)", -118.1937, 33.7701, 2024,
  "College Park, MD", "NASA CCE Joint Science Workshop — University of Maryland (Poster)", -76.9378, 38.9897, 2023,
  "Chicago, IL", "AGU Fall Meeting 2022 — Chicago, IL (Poster)", -87.6298, 41.8781, 2022,
  "Montreal, QC", "ESA Annual Meeting 2022 — Montreal, QC", -73.5673, 45.5019, 2022,
  "Fresno, CA", "FIRA 2022 — Fresno, CA (Poster)", -119.7871, 36.7378, 2022,
  "West Lafayette, IN", "IoT for Precision Agriculture Annual Meeting — Purdue University, West Lafayette, IN", -86.9081, 40.4259, 2022,
  "San Francisco, CA", "AGU Annual Symposium 2020 — San Francisco, CA (Poster)", -122.4194, 37.7749, 2020,
  "Philadelphia, PA", "IoT4Ag Annual Meeting 2025 — Philadelphia, PA", -75.1652, 39.9526, 2025,
  "Brisbane, AU", "IGARSS 2025 — Brisbane, Australia", 153.0251, -27.4698, 2025,
  "Houw Hoek, ZA", "NASA BioSCape Joint Science Workshop 2023 — Houw Hoek, South Africa", 18.4017, -34.0500, 2023
)

inst <- tibble::tibble(
  name  = "University of California Merced",
  popup = "University of California, Merced (Home Institution)",
  lng   = -120.4319402,
  lat   =  37.3633252
)

# -------------------------
# Styling
# -------------------------
site_hex <- "#d95f02"
conf_hex <- "#7570b3"
inst_hex <- "#1b9e77"

sites <- sites %>% mutate(radius = 7)
confs <- confs %>%
  mutate(radius = case_when(
    year >= 2025 ~ 8,
    year == 2024 ~ 7,
    year == 2023 ~ 6,
    TRUE ~ 5
  ))
inst <- inst %>% mutate(radius = 8)

# -------------------------
# Map
# -------------------------
m <- leaflet() %>%
  # Recommended basemaps
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Esri World Imagery") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap,  group = "Esri World Topo") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap,        group = "Open Topography") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron,   group = "CartoDB Positron") %>%
  

  # Hillshade overlay
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$Esri.WorldShadedRelief,
    group = "Hillshade",
    options = providerTileOptions(opacity = 0.55)
  ) %>%

  fitBounds(lng1 = -123.5, lat1 = -34.5, lng2 = 19.5, lat2 = 39) %>%

  # Research Sites
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = sites,
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    popup = ~popup,
    label = ~name,
    radius = ~radius,
    stroke = TRUE, color = site_hex, weight = 2,
    fillColor = site_hex, fillOpacity = 0.85,
    group = "Research Sites"
  ) %>%

  # Conference Travel
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = confs,
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    popup = ~popup,
    label = ~name,
    radius = ~radius,
    stroke = TRUE, color = conf_hex, weight = 2,
    fillColor = conf_hex, fillOpacity = 0.85,
    group = "Conference Travel"
  ) %>%

  # Home Institution
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = inst,
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    popup = ~popup,
    label = ~name,
    radius = ~radius,
    stroke = TRUE, color = inst_hex, weight = 2,
    fillColor = inst_hex, fillOpacity = 0.90,
    group = "Home Institution"
  ) %>%

  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c(
      "Esri World Imagery",
      "Esri World Topo",
      "Open Topography",
      "CartoDB Positron"
    ),
    overlayGroups = c(
      "Hillshade",
      "Research Sites",
      "Conference Travel",
      "Home Institution"
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%

  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") %>%
  addMiniMap(toggleDisplay = TRUE) %>%

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    colors = c(site_hex, conf_hex, inst_hex),
    labels = c("Research Sites", "Conference Travel", "Home Institution (UC Merced)"),
    title = "Legend",
    opacity = 1
  )

m



```
